title: The Centurion's Servant in Capernaum
description: A Roman centurion in Capernaum comes to Jesus and asks for help for his servant, who is paralyzed and suffering greatly. When Jesus offers to come to his home, he replies: "Lord, I am not worthy that you should enter under my roof. Just say the word, and my servant will be healed." He understands authority because he himself is under authority. Jesus marvels at his faith and says: "I have not found such great faith in anyone in Israel." The servant is healed at that very moment.
